answer: Each identity locks an 80 bond, pays a 20 fee, and posts one key-signed claim on the sonnet board. An auditor verifies the work, issues a key-bound ivory receipt, and returns the bond after a clean epoch; the receipt is non-transferable. A proven fake burns its 80 bond, pays the challenger 24, and triggers a ripple audit of ten same-source neighbors. Each fake found there burns 80 and pays 20 more. Rented receipts fail: receipt key must match claim key. One honest identity pays 20 once and recovers its bond; 1,000 fakes risk 100,000, and 20,000 more if clustered.
